      "snippet": "Yes — “nothing to commit” is good, and it tells us something very specific and useful.
What that result actually confirms
When git status says nothing to commit, working tree clean, it means:

The README is already committed

It has already been pushed to GitHub

The repo state on your device matches origin/main

So from GitHub’s point of view, the README is live.

Now the key question you’re really asking

“If you search, should it be easier to find now?”
